title: OMPI export manifest (Kubemoot reading of working spec v0.6)
$comment: Kubemoot's own schema, derived from sections 3.5.1 and 3.5.2 and the manifest working text in Notes D.1 of the OMPI exchange-and-runtime working spec v0.6, editors' draft of 2026-11-09 (commit 5fd045c5a492fd51aca4a65cdf817d5a9f37c8a1). Not an official OMPI artifact. The spec leaves the manifest to a separate proposal; this schema requires the fields the working text lists. The values of selection come from the working text's example and its wording (complete snapshot, a selection, a full history).
